_comment: Character class catalog (real data drives the schema). Each class carries HP/MP growth, movement range, XP curve, allowed races, optional MP source rules, and a list of non-spell class_abilities. Dropped from v1: _comment, allowed_weapons, allowed_armor, spell_type, mp_source.percentage, mp_regen_multiplier — all parsed but unread by v1's TS implementation. Spell access lives on Spell.allowable_classes (and Spell.class_min_levels for per-class level overrides), not here. `allowed_races` is kept even though v1's TS hardcoded the race-gate table — it's design-intent data and v2 should drive from JSON.

class_abilities.name: Turn Undead
class_abilities.description: From level 5, a Paladin can channel holy energy to Turn Undead: every undead on the battlefield must make a Wisdom save or be destroyed; those that succeed still take 50% of their HP in radiant damage.

class_abilities.name: Herbalism
class_abilities.description: Keen knowledge of flora lets Rangers spot reagents in the wild. When the party examines a tile, each Ranger rolls an INT save (d20 + INT mod vs DC 13) — success identifies a potion reagent.

class_abilities.name: Pick Locks
class_abilities.description: From level 3, a Ranger can pick locked doors and chests (d20 + DEX mod vs DC 12), consuming one lockpick per attempt — same mechanic as a Thief.

class_abilities.name: Detect Traps
class_abilities.description: From level 3, a Ranger's woodcraft reveals hidden traps before the party steps on them.

class_abilities.name: Herbalism
class_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of ingredients doubles the chance of finding reagents when examining the wilderness.
